prompts.text: What small change in everyday life tells you a new season has arrived?
Tell me about a yearly household task that always reminds you of a particular time of year.
The first cool evening of the season or the first heavy rain after a dry spell?
Some seasonal traditions begin with practical chores and end up becoming family rituals.
You're planning a relaxed weekend for a visitor during your favourite season. What local routine would you include?
Which food do people around you start looking for when the weather changes?
A familiar seasonal routine can be as memorable as a major annual festival.
Describe a day when the weather changed the usual way your neighbourhood spent time together.
Someone asks what to expect during the rainy season where you live. What everyday detail would you mention first?
What's a seasonal saying people use in your area even when the forecast doesn't match?
What do people usually chat about during a long shared journey in your area?
Tell me about learning a local transport custom from another passenger.
A ferry ride where everybody watches the water or a bus journey full of lively conversation?
Regular commuters often recognise each other without ever learning one another's names.
You're helping a visitor use your town's public transport for the first time. What unwritten rule would you mention?
Which familiar call or phrase do you associate with getting around your city?
The conversations on a short journey sometimes reveal more local character than a guidebook.
Describe a journey where fellow passengers made an unexpected delay enjoyable.
A friend wants to travel like a local rather than book a tour. What everyday route would you suggest?
What travel habit from your area would seem unusual to someone visiting for the first time?
What's a small gesture people use around you to show appreciation without saying much?
Tell me about misunderstanding a friendly gesture before somebody explained it.
A cheerful wave across the street or a quiet nod of recognition?
People sometimes know exactly what a gesture means within a family even if nobody has explained it.
You're meeting someone whose greeting gestures differ from yours. How would you follow their lead comfortably?
Which hand gesture do people around you use to ask for patience?
The smallest gestures of courtesy often become the easiest customs to adopt.
Describe seeing a familiar gesture used in a new setting and noticing its meaning had changed.
A friend wants to learn how people politely get someone's attention in your area. What would you demonstrate?
What's a gesture older relatives use that younger people rarely seem to copy?
